# Repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [the visual quality standard](../docs/ux/visual-quality.md). These apply to implementation and review alike.

Visual presentation is as important as functionality. Every frontend change needs a dedicated rendered visual review, ranked weaknesses, fixes and a review of the revised result before completion. Functional checks alone do not establish visual quality. PR reviews must check the evidence and flag missing visual sign-off; do not claim to have inspected an interface unless you actually did.
